scope: Read-only protocol, implementation, source admission and immutable input metadata review before current analysis; no patient or virtual rows decoded and no current target effects inspected.
checks: All 25 bound paths and bytes/hashes, both immutable generation manifests, and relevant receipts were checked without decoding tables; all planned six initial authors and both dependent R04 branches have all three seeds.
The operator is Pearson correlation of outcome residuals after an intercept, continuous age and sex; TC-HDL is not additionally adjusted for BMI.
Strict age >18 and one common complete-case set for the five canonical columns are explicit; the prior >=18 count is not reused.
Positive unit changes and sample-SD standardization are correlation-invariant; generated mmol/L units are explicitly converted by 38.67.
All three pairs are retained for every input; failed table analyses remain three null slots rather than being replaced or dropped.
Input hashes and freeze files are checked before analysis, and input hashes are checked again after it; closed analysis cannot be silently repeated.
The two implementation findings were repaired: counts are saved before a possible analyze() failure, and invalid nonmissing values fail even when another value in that row is missing.

The seven existing invented operator tests are retained under their historical code hash; the three affected invented-row revision tests passed under the current code hash. Passed tests were not redundantly rerun by this reviewer.
limitations: This is a methods-guided partial reanalysis of three available biomarkers, not an unchanged original-author code pipeline or the original ten-biomarker matrix.
Common-case deletion and positivity rules are declared investigator choices; original pregnancy/interview/extreme-outlier exclusions cannot be fully reconstructed.
The real cohort and generated laws are already exposed developmental material. This is neither a new independent population nor a prospective confirmation.
No original full-matrix FDR claim, equivalence cutoff, or population-truth claim is licensed; seed ranges are conditional simulation variation.
